messages:
incbot: Pager: high tail-latency + intermittent 5xx from APAC dedicated pool (nodegroup-2). Paging @maya and @samir. :rotating_light:

maya: I got the page, joining. Looking at traces now. Will take lead on comms and handoff. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: oncall ack. seeing backlog on nodegroup-2, GC-like stalls on GPUs and higher queue depth. preliminary: scheduling/regression after last-night kernel change.

lucas: I pushed that kernel change in the 02:00 deploy. If we need to, I can stage a rollback — ~5m to stage + ~10m drain.

anne: ops: we can also route new APAC traffic to EU as an immediate mitigation. Prep snippet for routing policy change ready.

maya: plan: 1) publish initial public brief (draft below) 2) apply routing policy to shift new sessions -> EU 3) lucas rolls kernel rollback if perf doesn't recover. Samir will monitor.

maya: DRAFT initial public brief (for review):
```
We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors affecting some requests served from APAC dedicated capacity. Impact: a subset of APAC-dedicated customers may experience slower responses or transient errors. Our on-call team is actively investigating and implementing mitigations (traffic reroute and configuration rollback). Next update in ~20 minutes. No evidence of data loss at this time.
```

anne: suggest swapping "APAC dedicated capacity" -> "some APAC capacity" (less product-internal phrasing). Also add a link to support contact.

legal: wording: replace "No evidence of data loss" with "No evidence of data loss at this time" (so it's timeboxed). Avoid naming internal components.

jamie: product side: add note re: potential SLA impact for affected customers and that we're prioritizing those accounts. Can we include incident reference INC-2790 for tracking?

maya: updated draft with legal/product/ops edits:
```
We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors affecting some requests from APAC capacity. Impact: a subset of APAC-dedicated customers may see slower responses or transient errors. Our on-call team is actively investigating and implementing mitigations, including routing traffic to other regions and configuration rollback. We are prioritizing affected accounts and working to restore normal service. No evidence of data loss at this time. (Incident ref: INC-2790)
Next update in ~20 minutes.
```

samir: starting incremental mitigation: enable prefix-cache warmup for the APAC pool and raise scheduler timeouts. Monitoring traces and error rates.

anne: applying routing policy now: shifting new sessions from APAC-dedicated -> EU-dedicated. ETA ~2m. Will post policy change diff.

incbot: Automated: statuspage draft posted to incident INC-2790 (internal).

lucas: rolling back kernel change now. Starting staged rollback on nodegroup-2. Will notify when each batch completes.

samir: metrics: errors down 40% on nodes we've patched; end-to-end p95 latency trending down. Still watching queue depth.

lucas: rollback completed on nodegroup-2 (all batches).

anne: routing change fully in effect. APAC new sessions now routed to EU where appropriate.

maya: updating public brief to include mitigation steps and ETA for next update. Proposed next public update:
```
Update: We have implemented traffic routing to other regions and completed a configuration rollback on affected APAC nodes. Error rates and latency are improving; we will continue to monitor. Impacted customers should see restoration over the next few minutes. We will provide a final resolution update once verified. (INC-2790)
```

samir: root cause (prelim): a GPU kernel regression causing scheduler stalls under certain batch/seqsize patterns. Engineering will do a full RCA.

legal: ack on phrasing. Good to include "investigating" and "improving" language.

jamie: prod: notify top-tier APAC customers via support with the incident ref and expected resolution window (30-45m).

maya: FINAL resolve draft for public:
```
Resolved: We mitigated increased latency and intermittent errors impacting some APAC capacity by rolling back a recent configuration change and routing new sessions to alternate regions. Error rates and latency have returned to baseline and no evidence of data loss was found. We will follow up with a detailed RCA. (INC-2790)
```

samir: marking root cause for RCA tracking and postmortem. I'll post the RCA draft in eng channel when ready.

maya: closing notes: thanks all for quick responses — will publish the public updates in the status system now and open a follow-up PM for RCA, timeline, and customer outreach. :white_check_mark:

incbot: Automated: incident INC-2790 marked Resolved in status system (final update published).
